subject.title: Text between tool calls leaks to messaging channels

question: Should direct/source messaging chats keep automatic bare-text final delivery by default, or move to message-tool-only/final-only delivery to prevent inter-tool text leaks?
rationale: Current main has partial safeguards, but the remaining safe default is a compatibility and product decision because stricter delivery can suppress replies for users whose agents rely on automatic bare-text DMs.

options.title: Ship an opt-in strict policy first
options.body: Preserve current automatic defaults while adding or repairing a documented direct-chat-safe final-only/message-tool-only mode with regression coverage.

options.title: Change defaults broadly
options.body: Make direct/source chats message-tool-only or final-only by default and pair the change with upgrade guidance and doctor checks for affected users.

options.title: Accept current partial mitigation
options.body: Keep automatic defaults and commentary-phase guards as-is, accepting that ordinary unphased intermediate text can still leak on some paths.

recommendation.title: Ship an opt-in strict policy first
recommendation.body: Preserve current automatic defaults while adding or repairing a documented direct-chat-safe final-only/message-tool-only mode with regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current delivery-policy lines and recent review context point to steipete as the best available routing owner for the product/defaults decision.
